name: Yuen Ka Ying
source:
"We know not what feud exists between you and the fu-zhaizhu's faction."

Conjoined twins, fated from birth to become half-machine. Just and honourable, the Yuen brothers are renowned in the Qingyun Society as the "Twin Yuen Heroes." A Waijia master, Ka Ying wields twin hook swords.
